findings.summary: The new direct Unix-stream TPM adapter does not provide complete TPM response framing.
findings.evidence: tpm-contracts.md:240–242 selects net.DialUnix followed directly by transport.FromReadWriteCloser. In go-tpm v0.9.8, that adapter calls tpmutil.RunCommandRaw, which performs one Read into a4096-byte buffer; a Unix byte-stream Read may return a partial response. A fragmented valid response can fail parsing or leave bytes for the following command.
findings.fix: Use an existing suitable packet-aware swtpm adapter or a test-only transport.TPM Send implementation that serializes commands, fully writes each command, reads the10-byte TPM header with io.ReadFull, validates the declared response size against a fixed bound, and reads the complete remainder. Add fragmented-header/body, EOF and oversize-response fixtures; the identical unfragmented recipe must pass.

findings.summary: The new emulator invocation says swtpm2 instance without selecting the required socket interface.
findings.evidence: tpm-contracts.md:255–257 lists socket flags after “start an owned swtpm2 instance”; the pinned executable is swtpm and the interface is selected by its socket subcommand.
findings.fix: Name the invocation explicitly as swtpm socket --tpm2 followed by the listed private-state/data/control flags.
